case.summary: Case CASE-015 involves three card-not-present transactions (4012180, 4012181, 4012182) on card SC-03015-K952 totaling $304.10 exposure. The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012180 at 0.83 [EV-70087d11]. The transactions originated from a new device (Windows Desktop MatchOS) and an anonymous proxy IP in Argentina [EV-8cb9add3, EV-c756485a]. Velocity analysis shows three online transactions within 48 hours, above the card's $101.37 average [EV-68e9b258, EV-beee32dc]. The device fingerprint appears in a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-839228f3], and the customer has a prior fraud case CC-4323 [EV-06ff48ed]. The customer reports the purchases as unauthorized and confirms physical card possession [EV-9fab82c2]. Pattern retrieval identified six similar prior cases [EV-b38b0b7e].
